scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/size_budget.mjs && node scripts/pwa_check.mjs
scripts.check:mobile: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=mock vite build --outDir /tmp/kb-dist-check --emptyOutDir && python3 scripts/mobile_check.py --dist /tmp/kb-dist-check --interact --stress
scripts.check:a11y: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=mock vite build --outDir /tmp/kb-dist-a11y --emptyOutDir && python3 scripts/a11y_check.py --dist /tmp/kb-dist-a11y
scripts.check:pwa: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=mock vite build --outDir /tmp/kb-dist-pwa --emptyOutDir && python3 scripts/pwa_browser_check.py --dist /tmp/kb-dist-pwa
scripts.check:speed: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=mock vite build --outDir /tmp/kb-dist-speed --emptyOutDir && python3 scripts/perf_check.py --dist /tmp/kb-dist-speed
